Idealerweise Erfahrung im Kundenservice, Beschwerdemanagement oder Callcenter. Quereinsteiger mit dem richtigen Gespür sind ebenfalls willkommen. Ein ruhiger Arbeitsplatz, stabiles Internet, PC oder Laptop und ein Headset. Wichtig – Arbeitsmittel: Ein Windows-Laptop oder Windows-PC sowie ein Headset werden nicht vom Arbeitgeber gestellt. Du bringst beides selbst mit und nutzt es für deine Arbeit. Das bieten wir 2.500 € Gehalt pro Monat. Arbeitszeiten: Montag - Freitag von 08:30 - 17:00 Uhr. 100 % Remote: Du arbeitest von überall auf der Welt. Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, Start ab sofort. Eine gründliche Einarbeitung in unsere Produkte und Abläufe. Kurze Wege ins Team und direkt zur Geschäftsführung. Eine Aufgabe mit Sinn: Du hilfst Menschen, die gerade gestresst sind. jobs.title: Associate Product Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops. Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide , from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day . We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams. We're 100 people , profitable , and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin. We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team. In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit. We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations. Learn how product is built from the inside, working side by side with our CPO. As our Associate Product Manager, you'll work directly with our CPO as a force multiplier for the product team. You'll take on high-impact work across customer research, product data, product marketing and adoption - topics that span the whole product org rather than a single product area. Who We Want Hungry learner You're eager to learn fast, actively seek feedback and turn it into visible progress within weeks, not months. Structured self-starter You're highly organized, bring order to messy situations and get things done without step-by-step guidance. Analytical thinker You're comfortable with data and can pull numbers from spreadsheets or analytics tools and turn them into clear insights. Customer-curious You enjoy talking to users, ask good follow-up questions and turn interviews into actionable takeaways. Clear communicator You write crisply, build clean slides and feel comfortable presenting to customers, e.g. in webinars. Scrappy generalist You're happy to switch between product marketing, data, research and ops, and no task is "beneath you". jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Operations Technology (All Genders)
jobs.address: Berlin, Tauentzienstraße, City West, Charlottenburg, Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf, Berlin, 10789, Deutschland
jobs.description:
About the role: What's in the Box

The Logistics Tribe builds the systems powering end-to-end delivery across North America, Europe and Australia/New Zealand: getting fresh ingredients into our facilities, giving customers the best delivery options the network can support, and tracking every box to the customer's door. Today it is a single engineering team - two staff engineers, a data engineer and seven mid-to-senior engineers - led by the Director of Engineering, owning that software and keeping it running in production. You will join as an Engineering Manager and take line management of the seven.

The work is operations-heavy and business-critical, spread across different subdomains. You won't own a fixed backlog in one corner of the domain; the team's scope follows where the business pressure is. That is reflected in how we work: rather than one fixed squad, the team organises into small, project-focused pods that form and dissolve as projects start and finish. In a typical sprint, your engineers might be spread across three projects with three different product managers.

Strategy and technical direction are things we shape together - staff engineers, product managers and you all contributing, nobody working from a script handed down. You own the people and the delivery of your engineers.

The role reports to the Director of Engineering for Logistics Tech; your team is spread across two geographies.

What you'll do: The Recipe

  • Lead and grow a team of mid-to-senior engineers: set clear expectations, give regular and honest feedback, and own their development - including building the case when someone is ready for the next level.
  • Own the people and stay technical. This role carries real hands-on expectations - you still deliver code yourself, not management at a distance.
  • Keep raising the team's AI bar: role-model it in your own work, and push the workflows where AI genuinely changes how fast we deliver.
  • Make our project-based way of working work for people. You lead project staffing with the Director of Engineering and the product managers, putting engineers where the work and their growth both fit. You limit how many projects anyone carries, and you keep handovers clean so nobody becomes a single point of failure.
  • Own the delivery health of your team's work together with the product managers and the engineers leading each project: realistic plans, sound quality, and systems that stay reliable once shipped.
  • Hire and onboard well - you'll be building the team's balance of skills as projects and domains shift under you.
  • Champion the engineering practices we care about: behaviour-driven tests for every business use case, and small iterations.
  • Help shape tribe culture as part of the leadership team, in a setup that is deliberately flat and collaborative.

What you'll bring: The Ingredients

  • At least 2 years leading mid-to-senior engineers in an agile environment, backed by 6+ years of total engineering experience - you've run development and growth conversations and seen people through to promotion.
  • Comfort leading people through changing project boundaries - this is a team that reforms around projects, not one that sits still.
  • A backend-leaning technical grounding - event-driven microservices, Kubernetes, Kafka, relational databases, CI/CD - with real BDD/TDD habits that make large refactorings safe. You don't need to be the deepest engineer in the room, but you need to earn the team's respect.
  • Daily, practical experience building with AI tooling: you've shipped real work with it, you know where it fails, and you learn as readily from others as they learn from you.
  • A product-oriented mindset: you can reason about the business problem, prioritise for customer impact, and push back on low-value scope.
  • Genuine interest in physical-world and supply-chain problems. You want to understand how the operation actually works; logistics or carrier integration experience is a plus.

Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don't "tick all the boxes" but think you'd thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer

  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
  • Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
  • Invest in your growth with a German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

jobs.description: Description In ganz Europa stehen Fuhrparks unter enormem Druck. Kraftstoffkosten steigen, regulatorische Anforderungen werden komplexer und der Umstieg auf emissionsärmere Fahrzeuge nimmt Fahrt auf. Gleichzeitig verwalten noch immer rund 70 % der europäischen Unternehmen ihre Flotten mit Excel-Tabellen, isolierten Tools und Prozessen, die für die heutigen Herausforderungen nie ausgelegt waren. Shiftmove macht genau das einfacher. Wir sind ein profitables B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen und die am schnellsten wachsende Flottenmanagement-Plattform Europas. Entstanden aus dem Zusammenschluss von Avrios und Vimcar, unterstützen wir heute zehntausende Geschäftskunden in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien, der Schweiz, Polen und weiteren europäischen Märkten. Mit den jüngsten Akquisitionen von Optimum und Ocean in Frankreich haben wir unsere Präsenz weiter ausgebaut und unsere Position in einem der größten Flottenmärkte Europas gestärkt. Unsere KI-gestützte Plattform verbindet Fahrzeugdaten in Echtzeit mit intelligenter Software, damit Unternehmen ihre Fahrzeuge smarter beschaffen, Kosten kontrollieren, Compliance sicherstellen und die Mobilitätswende aktiv gestalten können – alles an einem Ort. Über die Rolle Als Account Manager:in übernimmst du die kommerzielle Verantwortung für ein bestehendes Kundenportfolio und trägst aktiv zum Wachstum von Shiftmove bei. Dein Ziel ist es, bestehende Kundenbeziehungen nicht nur langfristig zu sichern, sondern ihr Potenzial gezielt auszuschöpfen – durch Renewals, Upselling, Cross-Selling und die Entwicklung neuer Umsatzmöglichkeiten. Dabei betreust du ein umfangreiches Portfolio an B2B-Kunden mit einem Geschäftsvolumen von rund 4–5 Mio. €. Du erkennst kommerzielle Chancen, gehst proaktiv auf Kunden zu, führst Vertrags- und Preisverhandlungen und bringst Opportunities erfolgreich zum Abschluss. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Customer Success Team zusammen, übernimmst aber die eigenständige Verantwortung für die kommerzielle Entwicklung deiner Accounts. Das erwartet dich Account Management & Kundenentwicklung: Du betreust eigenverantwortlich ein Portfolio aus Mid-Market-Kund und ausgewählten Enterprise Accounts. Du behältst den Überblick über deine Accounts, priorisierst Chancen und Risiken und definierst klare nächste Schritte. Renewal Management: Du verantwortest die Verlängerung bestehender Verträge – von der Vorbereitung des Angebots über die Abstimmung mit Kund bis hin zur Preisverhandlung und zum Abschluss. Expansion: Gemeinsam mit Customer Success identifizierst du Upsell- und Cross-Selling-Potenziale und entwickelst daraus konkrete Opportunities. Du verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kund und kannst nachvollziehbar vermitteln, welchen Mehrwert zusätzliche Produkte oder Lösungen für sie schaffen. Stakeholder Management: Du kommunizierst mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartner auf Kundenseite und lernst, auch komplexere Entscheidungsprozesse strukturiert zu steuern. Pipeline & Forecasting: Du dokumentierst relevante Entwicklungen in Salesforce und Planhat, hältst deine Opportunities aktuell und erstellst realistische Forecasts für deine Pipeline. Was du mitbringst B2B Sales Erfahrung: Du bringst ca. 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit, idealerweise im SaaS- oder Subscription-Umfeld, z.B. im Account Management, Existing Customer Sales oder als Account Executive. Verhandlungsgeschick & Closing: Du hast bereits eigenständig Verkaufsgespräche geführt, kommerzielle Verhandlungen gesteuert und Deals erfolgreich abgeschlossen, idealerweise im fünfstelligen Bereich. Portfolio Management: Du hast Erfahrung in der Betreuung und kommerziellen Entwicklung eines größeren Kundenportfolios und weißt, wie du Accounts und Opportunities effektiv priorisierst. Sales Drive & Proaktivität: Du gehst aktiv auf Kunden zu, erkennst Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und hast Freude daran, Umsatzpotenziale in konkrete Abschlüsse umzuwandeln. Consultative Selling: Du verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kunden und kannst den Mehrwert einer Lösung überzeugend vermitteln, statt dich ausschließlich auf Produktfeatures zu konzentrieren. Lernbereitschaft & Coachability: Du bist offen für Feedback, möchtest dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln und probierst gerne neue Ansätze aus. Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau. Warum uns? Produkte mit echtem Impact: Wir lösen reale Herausforderungen für tausende Unternehmen in ganz Europa und machen komplexe Flottenprozesse einfacher, effizienter und datengetriebener. Etwas Sinnvolles skalieren: Als profitables, PE-finanziertes Scale-up mit ambitionierten Wachstumszielen verbinden wir Stabilität mit Geschwindigkeit und Gestaltungsspielraum. Internationales Umfeld: Über 40 Nationalitäten, Englisch als Unternehmenssprache und Teams in ganz Europa sorgen für spannende Perspektiven und echte Zusammenarbeit. Verantwortung statt Micromanagement: Wir geben Menschen den Freiraum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Ideen einzubringen und Dinge voranzutreiben. Benefits 30 Urlaubstage Workation: Bis zu 6 Wochen pro Jahr remote von überall auf der Welt arbeiten Hundefreundliches Büro: Weil tierische Kolleg einfach dazugehören 🐶 Weiterentwicklung: 2.000 € jährliches Budget für persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung Benefits nach Wahl: Urban Sports Club, Hrmony, JobRad oder Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket/BVG-Ticket Wellbeing: 1 Mental Health Day plus Zugang zu nilo.health Für Foodies: Kostenloses Mittagessen einmal pro Woche, gemeinsames Frühstück alle zwei Wochen sowie Snacks und Getränke rund um die Uhr 🍕 We mean it! Mit über 40 Nationalitäten verbindet uns vor allem eines: der gemeinsame Anspruch, Mobilität für Unternehmen einfacher zu machen. Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven machen unsere Arbeit besser. Uns ist nicht wichtig, ob dein Lebenslauf perfekt aussieht. Bewirb dich trotzdem. Und wenn du im Bewerbungsprozess etwas brauchst oder Anpassungen notwendig sind, sag einfach Bescheid – wir finden eine Lösung.

jobs.title: Data Scientist (all genders)
jobs.description: At flaconi, we believe that diversity fuels creativity, innovation and growth. It thrives in all its forms of beauty. Our team is a mosaic of individuals from different backgrounds, cultures and life journeys, all united by a shared passion for beauty. Our commitment is grounded in our core values, particularly #trustinpeople . We hold ourselves accountable for creating an environment where every employee feels honestly valued, heard and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives to foster belonging. flaconi is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes and encourages all qualified from all backgrounds and identities, regardless of ethnicity, race, gender identity, migration background, national origin, disability status, sexual orientation, religion, or age to apply. If you require specific support during the application or interview process – e.g. live captions, more time for the interview or the task in a different format – just let us know so that we can adapt the process accordingly. We will do our best to make this possible. We are seeking a (Senior) Data Scientist (all genders) to join a dynamic team of five within our DATA department. You'll dive into diverse challenges including training and deploying machine learning models, developing Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, and statistical modeling. We believe in flat hierarchies, which means you'll work closely with colleagues of various seniorities in a fun environment. You'll play a key role in extracting valuable insights and developing data and AI solutions to optimize our e-commerce platform across Europe, taking end-to-end ownership of your projects and collaborating closely with business stakeholders along the way. Your contributions will have a direct impact on business decisions and process efficiency across a wide spectrum of unique use cases. Your Role Employ statistical techniques and machine learning algorithms for regression, classification, and clustering (e.g., Gradient Boosting, Random Forest, Hierarchical Clustering, ensemble methods). Develop and productionalize Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions alongside modern NLP techniques using transformer architectures (e.g., BERT, GPT). Utilize time-series forecasting methods (e.g., ARIMA, LSTM, DeepAR, Prophet) for predictive modeling. Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA), advanced feature engineering, and dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE). Develop and implement deep learning models in PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras while leveraging transfer learning strategies. Showcase your skills across key e-commerce data science use cases including demand forecasting, churn and CLTV modeling, pricing, customer segmentation, recommender systems, and personalization. Handle large-scale datasets using distributed computing frameworks (Apache Spark) on a tech stack comprising Python (PySpark, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, LightGBM), SQL, Databricks (Data Lakehouse & ML platform), AWS (S3, Lambda, EC2, SageMaker, Bedrock), GitHub, and AI-augmented tools (Claude, Copilot) while collaborating directly to proactively address stakeholder business needs. Your Profile Bring a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in developing and deploying machine learning solutions for real-world business problems. Demonstrate background exposure to e-commerce (ideal) , fintech , or fast-paced agency environments. Demonstrate hands-on experience with Databricks as a Data & AI platform (required) alongside cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. Prove hands-on experience in building, productionalizing, and deploying Generative AI or Agentic AI solutions. Apply hands-on experience with MLOps practices and tools (required) for end-to-end model lifecycle management. Possess a strong grasp of core data science principles to select the most appropriate techniques, combined with advanced proficiency in SQL, Python (PySpark, scikit-learn, NumPy, matplotlib, pandas), and AI-augmented development tools (Claude, Copilot). Communicate exceptionally in English (written and verbal) to articulate complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders, driving projects with full end-to-end ownership as a collaborative team player. We care about your well being : We want to support you also during difficult times. For this, we offer you and your close relatives counseling sessions with mental health professionals. flaconi fitness : a wide range of sports options & discounts on memberships. Family first: Our “emergency-daycare” is there for you in out-of-the-ordinary situations to look after your child on site at our office. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Release Engineering
jobs.description: Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. About Superhuman Superhuman is the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. You will own how code travels from a developer’s commit to millions of users across Superhuman’s products: Grammarly, Superhuman Docs, and Superhuman Mail. As our product suite grows, so do the number of engineers contributing to it and the number of surfaces we release on (web, desktop, mobile, browser extensions, APIs). Our team makes shipping fast, safe, and boring. The team builds and runs the CI/CD platform, release pipelines, and rollout tooling that let product teams deploy many times a day with confidence; it enables engineers to be productive, use new technologies to optimize the SLDC, and push on green many times a day. You will lead a team of engineers working at the intersection of developer productivity, infrastructure, and reliability. You will partner with Product Engineering, SRE, Platform/Infrastructure, and Security to increase release speed and safety. This role is hands-on: you will help set the technical direction and stay close to the work. As an Engineering Manager, Release Engineering, you will: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Engineers; hire great people and build a strong, inclusive team culture in Berlin and across a distributed organization. Own the strategy and roadmap for CI/CD, build, and release systems that scale with company growth and the number of products and surfaces we ship. Drive faster, safer delivery: improve lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and time to restore, and make these measures visible to engineering leadership. Build and operate release tooling, including progressive rollouts, canaries, feature flags, automated rollback, and release health monitoring. Coordinate release trains and launches across all our products, working with Product, QA, Support, and Marketing to ensure major launches land smoothly. Partner with SRE, Infrastructure, and Security to keep the delivery platform reliable and compliant, including supply chain security, artifact integrity, and access controls. Reduce friction for product engineers: cut build and test times, eliminate flaky tests and pipelines, and offer self-service paths so teams can ship without waiting on us. Act as an escalation point and Incident Commander for release-related incidents, and lead blameless postmortems that turn into lasting fixes. Balance near-term pipeline fixes with foundational investments, and make clear tradeoffs in a fast-moving environment. Stay hands-on where it matters: review designs, help debug tough pipeline problems, and set a high engineering bar. Qualifications Have 5+ years of software, DevOps, or release/build engineering experience, and 2+ years managing engineers (or engineering managers) with a record of hiring, developing, and retaining talent. Bring hands-on depth in CI/CD systems and build tooling (for example, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Buildkite, Bazel, or similar) and can reason independently about pipeline architecture and trade-offs. Know cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and Kubernetes or another container orchestration system. Have shipped and operated release systems at scale, using progressive delivery, feature flags, canary releases, and safe rollback. Understand release practices across multiple surfaces (web, desktop, mobile, browser extensions, or backend services). Know infrastructure as code (eg Terraform) and observability tooling, and use delivery metrics (DORA) to guide decisions. Have experience as an Incident Commander and running blameless postmortems. Know the basics of software supply chain security: dependency management, artifact signing, and secrets handling. Have experience managing people in a distributed or remote setting, and can collaborate effectively with Product, SRE, Security, QA, and Support. Operate well in ambiguity, set a high engineering bar, and empower senior engineers to own technical decisions. Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments. Compensation and Benefits Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback. A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture supported by our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our employee resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs. Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

jobs.description: About Us 1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries. Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity. About the Team Our enterprise team serves internationally operating companies that want to simplify mobile connectivity across borders. Instead of many contracts with different network operators, they get one provider, one platform and consistent processes from 1GLOBAL, including eSIM, IoT connectivity and API integration. We work directly with customers and indirectly through resellers and distributors, in the DACH region and across our other markets. We are growing with our existing customers, through our partners and from new inbound requests. Many of these opportunities don't need a long enterprise sales cycle; they need fast and reliable closing. That is where you come in: you own this business independently, with your own targets and short paths into the team. You will be the first person in this role and shape it from day one. About the Role You win revenue with our existing customers, partners and new inbound requests: from identifying needs through quoting and negotiation to signature and activation. With your own sales targets, you own a clearly defined segment and work closely with our enterprise and partner teams in the DACH region and internationally. Grow existing customers You manage a portfolio of existing customers, spot additional needs (more countries, users, plans or IoT use cases) and turn them into upsell and cross-sell deals. You own contract renewals and expansions, from timely outreach through to signature. You are your customers' first point of contact in sales and resolve requests quickly, together with Customer Success or Support where needed. Qualify and close new opportunities You handle inbound requests, qualify them in a first call and close small and mid-sized deals yourself. You hand larger opportunities over to our enterprise sales team, well prepared, and support them through to closing. You use campaigns, events and referrals to start new conversations with companies in our focus segments. Activate partner revenue You support our resellers and distributors day to day: with quotes for their end customers, pricing questions and orders. You make sure new partners are up and running quickly and close their first deals. You identify which partners have more potential and agree next steps with Partner Management. From quote to activation You prepare quotes, negotiate terms within our pricing guidelines and take deals through to signature. You manage the path from order to activation, because revenue only starts once connections go live. You keep your pipeline and forecast up to date in our CRM so we always know where we stand. Requirements About You Must Have Fluent German and English, spoken and written: you negotiate and write in both languages every day Completed commercial apprenticeship or a degree, plus 1 to 4 years of B2B sales experience, for example in inside sales, account management, as an SDR/BDR or in sales support with direct customer contact Drive to close: you enjoy working towards targets and follow up until the deal is signed Fluent German and English, spoken and written: you negotiate and write in both languages every day Structure and reliability: you keep many deals and orders moving in parallel and see each one through Confident on the phone, by email and on video calls, with a friendly and solution-oriented tone Experience with CRM systems and confident with MS Office, especially Excel Nice to Have Experience in telecommunications or IT, for example with a network operator, service provider, system integrator or distributor Experience in indirect sales with resellers and distributors Experience with quoting and contract processes in an enterprise environment Additional languages, for example Dutch, Spanish, French, Polish or Portuguese Benefits Why 1GLOBAL? Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs. Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry. Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals. Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts. Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field. International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company. Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment. Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry. 1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally. About the Team The Data Engineering team sits within the Central Data function, reporting to the Head of Data. We own the full data value chain: ingestion from source systems (billing, CRM, network, product, support, compliance), the data lake and warehouse layers, data quality and freshness. We don't own what the numbers mean — that's the business's call — but we own making sure the numbers are correct, timely, and traceable back to source. You'll join Data Engineering as a hands-on engineer working on our core lake platform — ingesting high-volume network and customer data, modeling it into clean, reliable datasets, and making it available for reporting and self-service analytics across the business. About the Role Develop and implement data models, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across raw and curated layers Create and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from source systems (billing, CRM, network, product, support) into our S3-based data lake Consume from and build reliable logic around Kafka topics, handling late, duplicate, or out-of-order events as they arrive Own data transformations in dbt, with tests and documentation so trust in the numbers is built in, not bolted on Orchestrate and monitor pipelines in Airflow, including retries, alerting, backfills, and SLAs Write efficient, well-structured SQL for transformation logic and ad-hoc investigation Contribute to data quality checks — completeness, freshness, reconciliation against source — and flag anomalies before they reach reporting Collaborate with team members to ensure smooth development processes and shared understanding. Take ownership of the quality and outcomes of your work, ensuring fully functional end-to-end flows. Create and maintain accurate, up-to-date technical documentation. Actively contribute to team discussions, with a mindset for continuous improvement and openness to new ideas or technologies. Requirements About You Must Have 3-5 years of hands-on data engineering experience Strong SQL — comfortable with window functions, CTEs, query optimization Solid experience building and maintaining data pipelines on AWS S3, Glue, and Athena (or a closely comparable lake/warehouse stack — e.g. Spark + Hive/EMR, BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake, Exasol — if you know the S3/Glue/Athena equivalents well) Practical understanding of data modelling: raw → conformed layers, dimensional modelling basics, thinking about how a table will actually be queried Experience consuming from Kafka (or another streaming/message system) as a data source Advanced proficiency in Python for ETL development, data manipulation and system automation Strong communication skills Nice to Have Airflow — DAG design, retries, backfills dbt — modelling, testing, documentation Exposure to Apache Iceberg or other open table formats Experience in telecom or another high-volume, regulated data environment (finance, healthcare) Benefits What We Offer? CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company Extended parental leave — 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave. Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child Why 1GLOBAL? Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs. Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry. Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals. Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts. Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field. International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company. Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment. Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry. 1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally. Wir sind stolz darauf, diese Auszeichnung erneut erhalten zu haben und damit offiziell zu den attraktivsten Arbeitgebern unserer Branche zu zählen - mit Brief und Siegel. was uns besonders macht Bei uns stehen deine Fragen, Feedback und Anregungen stets im Mittelpunkt, denn wir möchten, dass du dich bei uns wirklich wohlfühlst. Unser strukturierter Onboarding-Prozess sorgt dafür, dass du einen guten Start hast. Zudem legen wir großen Wert auf die kontinuierliche Förderung unserer Mitarbeitenden, damit du dich persönlich und beruflich weiterentwickeln kannst. JETZT DURCHSTARTEN blicke hinter die kulissen und erlebe den unterschied unverbindliches kennenlernen finde heraus, ob wir ein gutes match wären auf die chemie kommt's an Bei uns erwarten dich nicht nur spannende Aufgaben und ein unterstützendes Team, sondern auch eine gezielte Förderung deiner beruflichen Entwicklung. Wir setzen auf offene Kommunikation, einen durchdachten Onboarding-Prozess und eine Kultur, in der dein Feedback geschätzt wird. Wir wollen, dass dein Job zu deinem Leben passt. Finde in einem unverbindlichen Kennenlerngespräch heraus, ob wir zueinander passen. JETZT TERMIN VEREINBAREN Gestalte deine Zukunft bei Uns Entdecke deine Karrierechancen Hast du dich auch schon einmal gefragt, ob Steuerberatung auch anders geht? Wir bei hok sind der Überzeugung: Ja, das geht! Steuerberatung geht frischer, digitaler und flexibler. Und genau das ist unser Anspruch! Wir, das sind über 40 bunt gemischte Teammitglieder an unseren Standorten in Berlin und Falkensee, die gerne über den Tellerrand hinausschauen und mit modernen, lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweisen dafür sorgen, dass unsere Mandant:innen aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen nachhaltig für die Zukunft gewappnet sind. Stattdessen bieten wir dir ein offenes und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem deine Ideen und dein Engagement gefragt sind. Wir setzen auf digitale Tools, die dir den Arbeitsalltag erleichtern und bieten dir die Flexibilität, die du brauchst, um Beruf und Privatleben perfekt zu vereinen. Bist du bereit, die Steuerberatung von morgen mitzugestalten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig ! Sicher nicht, um dich täglich mit Papierbergen und Aktenordnern herumzuschlagen – sondern weil du dich für die spannenden Themen interessierst, die unsere Branche zu bieten hat. Durch unsere digitale Arbeitsweise und schlanken Prozesse schaffen wir den nötigen Freiraum, damit du dich auf genau die Aufgaben konzentrieren kannst, die dir wirklich Spaß machen. Gemeinsam mit dir entwickeln wir dein individuelles Tätigkeitsprofil – mit Schwerpunkten, die zu deinen Interessen und Stärken passen. Dazu gehören unter anderem folgende Themen: Betreuung und Beratung von Mandant:innen Erstellung von Finanzbuchhaltungen Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen für verschiedene Rechtsformen Erstellung von Steuererklärungen Unterstützung bei betriebswirtschaftlichen Fragestellungen Mitgestaltung von Digitalisierungsprojekten und weiteren Spezialgebieten das bringst du mit Bei hok zählen Respekt und Teamgeist – diese Werte sind für uns nicht verhandelbar. Wenn du zudem motiviert bist und gerne eigenverantwortlich arbeitest, bringst du bereits die besten Voraussetzungen mit! Alles Weitere bringen wir dir sehr gerne bei. Jahrhundert ausmacht. Strenge Hierarchien, starre Arbeitszeiten und veraltete Ausstattung gehören nicht dazu. Unterstützung des Service-Teams bei der täglichen Organisation und Kommunikation. Erstellung von Werkstattaufträgen und Rechnungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Serviceberater. Vor- und Nachbereitung von Kundenterminen , inkl. Unterlagen, Fahrzeugschlüssel, Leihwagen etc. Koordination und Verwaltung von Mietfahrzeugen am Standort. Kassenführung und Abrechnung. Bearbeitung des Post- und E-Mail-Verkehrs im Servicebereich. Mitwirkung bei Aktionen und Kampagnen , z. B. saisonale Serviceangebote. Sicherstellung eines professionellen und aufgeräumten Empfangsbereichs . Das bringst du mit: Du hast eine kaufmännische Ausbildung oder Berufserfahrung im Empfangs-, Service- oder Kundenbereich. Du bist ein Organisationstalent und besitzt ein gutes Gespür für Menschen und Situationen. Ob am Telefon, persönlich oder schriftlich beweist du Kommunikationsstärke und setzt diese gewinnbringend ein. jobs.title: Ergotherapeut (m/w/d) Altersmedizin in Berlin-Charlottenburg
jobs.description: Ergotherapeut:in (m/w/d) Altersmedizin in Berlin-Charlottenburg Unsere Caritas-Klinik St. Anna (ehemals Malteser-Krankenhaus) in Berlin-Charlottenburg steht für moderne Medizin und spürbare Zuwendung. Bei uns steht der ältere Mensch im Mittelpunkt. Die uns anvertrauten Menschen können darauf vertrauen, dass sie medizinisch und pflegerisch bei uns in guten Händen sind und wir sie als Menschen mit ihrer gesamten Persönlichkeit und Einzigartigkeit wahrnehmen, behandeln und umsorgen. Was wir dir bieten Unverbindlich reinschnuppern: Möglichkeit, uns vor Ort zu testen, bevor du dich entscheidest Urlaubsregelung: Planung mit 30 Urlaubstagen Lage: In Berlin-Charlottenburg; 10 Minuten vom S Heerstraße, 15 Minuten vom S Westkreuz, 20 Minuten vom Bhf. Zoo Mobilität: Bezuschusstes Bike-Leasing oder Firmenticket für den öffentlichen Verkehr, kostenfreie Parkplätze für Autos Gesundheit und Freizeit: Zahlreiche Sport- und Fitnessangebote, Unterstützung bei der Ferienbetreuung für Kinder, zahlreiche Rabatte über Corporate Benefits Das ist besonders Finanzielles: Entgelt (AVR Caritas) mit tariflichen Steigerungen und Stufenanstieg alle zwei Jahre, Altersvorsorge sowie Jahressonderzahlung Flexibilität: Dienstzeiten innerhalb fester Behandlungszeiten von i.d.R. 8:00 bis 16:18h Gezielte Einarbeitung und Entwicklung: Einarbeitungs- und Fort- bzw. Weiterbildungs­konzept sowie Feedbackgespräche Deine Aufgabe Lebensqualität unterstützen: Einsatz motorisch-funktioneller oder sensomoto­risch-per­zeptiver Behandlungsverfahren zur Erhaltung und Steigerung der Lebensqualität unserer Patient:innen Methodenentwicklung: Mitdenken bei neuen Behandlungsmethoden, Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung von Betreuungskonzepten Beratung: Beratung von Angehörigen und Patient:innen bei Hilfsmittelwahl und ­Versorgung, Weiterleitung relevanter Hinweise an das ärztliche Team Dein Profil Ausbildung: Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Ergotherapeut:in oder ähnliches und besitzt Fachwissen in der Anwendung verschiedener Behandlungsmaßnahmen. Teamwork: Du verstehst es, Ziele im Team gemeinsam zu erreichen und auf die Bedürfnisse deines Gegenübers empathisch einzugehen. Deine Bewerbung Wenn du Fragen hast, erreichst du Anita Minke (Leitung Therapie) unter 030-30001-547. Requirements About You Must Have Admission as a lawyer in an EU jurisdiction or the UK or US; 3–6 years’ post-qualification experience, ideally with a focus on telecoms, technology, or digital regulation; Background at a top-tier law firm, telecoms regulator, or in-house in a tech or telecoms company; Deep knowledge of EU telecom and digital regulation; familiarity with Dutch or another EU country-specific regulatory environment is a plus; Strong stakeholder engagement skills and ability to translate complex regulation into clear business guidance; Fluent in English; proficiency in Dutch and/or German is advantageous but not essential; Proactive, commercially minded, and able to work independently in a cross-functional environment; Ability to work autonomously and to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and effectively with limited oversight, efficiently and quickly, yet also being able to participate as a team player; Be highly organised with the ability to prioritise assistance on projects and contracts from inception through to completion, all with strong attention to detail; Ability to get up to speed quickly and add value from day one, and availability to start in January 2027 and commit to the full duration of the fixed-term contract. Nice to Have In-house experience; Experience working for or engaging directly with a telecommunications regulatory authority; IP law experience or litigation experience; A keen interest in technology. Benefits Why 1GLOBAL? Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry. Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
